brief:
为 Hermès Terre d’Hermès 制作高品质商业香水海报。保留上传商品原貌与可见标签；为这款商品形成四个真正不同的创意方向。只使用品牌与产品名称，不添加价格、容量、促销、新品或功效宣传。
本次必须采用以下独立艺术方向，优先于通用风格要求；保留用户商品、文案和禁止事项：Night over worked earth: a flat matte ink-night card carrying one oversized hard-edge burnt-ember half-disc rising from the bottom edge, its crown passing behind the flacon's shoulders like a buried sun, crossed by one thin orange seam at the disc crown. The cutout is lifted into the upper two-thirds so the ember field below becomes a quiet plaque band: tracked geometric-sans brand line, then the name set wide and centred in Century Gothic capitals near band width, closed by a short rule floating between image and text like a print registration mark. No floor, no horizon - pure rising-disc geometry against translucent amber glass.

references.selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume advertisement featuring dynamic floral elements, clear campaign typography, and high-end product rendering suitable for design reference.

analysis.composition: Asymmetrical balance with the product and floral explosion on the left counterweighted by negative space and typography on the right.
analysis.negative_space: Significant dark gradient space on the right utilized for text placement.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic studio lighting with high contrast, highlighting the faceted glass and metallic cap against a dark background.
analysis.typography: Clean white sans-serif logo and serif tagline positioned in the right negative space; URL at the bottom.
analysis.information_density: Moderate; focuses on brand identity and a single tagline without clutter.

references.selection_reason: High-quality dynamic product shot capturing the spray mechanism in action against a clean gradient background. Excellent reference for minimalist perfume photography and liquid texture rendering.

analysis.composition: Diagonal orientation of the bottle creates dynamic movement, balanced by the spray plume extending into the upper left negative space.
analysis.negative_space: Generous gradient grey space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the fine mist particles.
analysis.lighting: Crisp studio lighting with high specular highlights on the glass and metal atomizer; soft drop shadow anchors the floating object.
analysis.information_density: Low; focus is entirely on the product form and function.

references.selection_reason: Highly resolved conceptual still-life featuring a Cartier fragrance integrated with vintage Edison bulbs. Strong visual metaphor and premium execution make it an excellent design reference.

analysis.composition: Symmetrical arrangement with the perfume bottle centered among hanging lightbulbs at varying heights, mirrored on a reflective surface below.
analysis.negative_space: Deep teal gradient background provides clean negative space around the illuminated subjects.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic practical lighting from the glowing filaments combined with a soft central backlight creating a halo effect behind the bottle.
analysis.typography: None. The text on the bottle is container labeling, not campaign typography.
analysis.information_density: Low, focused entirely on the visual concept and product.
